events.subtitle: COTTON CLUB debut — only 2026 performance
events.category: Japanese blues history / reunion-era lineup / 2026-only performance
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents WEST ROAD BLUES BAND on September 30, 2026, for the band's first appearance at the venue, with sets at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM. The announced lineup is Takashi “Hotoke” Nagai on guitar and vocals, Junshi Yamagishi on guitar, Teruo Matsumoto on drums, and Taku Nakajo on bass. The venue describes the band as a pioneer of Japan's blues scene, formed in 1972 and part of the 1970s Kansai blues boom. After suspending activity following Shinji Shiotsugu's death in 2008, the band returned at the 2025 Naniwa Blues Festival for its record-debut 50th anniversary. COTTON CLUB states that the September 30 engagement is the band's only performance of 2026 and is made possible by U.S.-based Yamagishi's temporary return to Japan. The standard table-seat music charge is ¥9,000 per person.

en.why_it_matters: This is a revival-era chapter of Japanese blues history rather than a generic legacy booking. Nagai, Yamagishi and Matsumoto reconnect a band that helped define the 1970s Kansai blues boom, with Nakajo on bass, for the group's only announced performance of 2026 while Yamagishi is back in Japan from the United States. In a close club room, the point is the surviving guitar-and-rhythm identity of that lineage and what it sounds like after the band's 2025 return.
en.trip_verdict: If September 30 overlaps a Tokyo stay, actively make room for one of the two sets and let Marunouchi anchor the evening. The one-day engagement makes the date especially worth securing within a Tokyo itinerary, but the sources do not establish a farewell that should reorganize an entire Japan trip.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es un capítulo de la etapa de regreso de una pieza importante de la historia del blues japonés, no una contratación nostálgica cualquiera. Nagai, Yamagishi y Matsumoto vuelven a conectar a una banda que ayudó a definir el boom de blues de Kansai en los setenta, con Nakajo en el bajo, para su única presentación anunciada de 2026 mientras Yamagishi está de regreso en Japón desde Estados Unidos. En una sala cercana, el centro está en esa identidad de guitarras y sección rítmica y en cómo suena después del retorno de 2025.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 30 de septiembre coincide con una estancia en Tokio, sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets y dejaría que Marunouchi ordene la noche. Que ocurra sólo ese día le da peso dentro del itinerario de Tokio, pero las fuentes no lo presentan como una despedida que justifique reconstruir todo un viaje a Japón.

events.category: Living masters / rare piano-bass duo / four-decade collaboration
events.factual_description: Roulette presents Matthew Shipp and William Parker in duo on Friday, December 4, 2026. Doors are at 7:00 PM and the performance begins at 8:00 PM. Roulette describes the concert as a rare duo appearance celebrating their four-decade collaboration. Their new studio album A Whole System Of, identified by Roulette as their fourth duo recording, is scheduled for November 6 on TAO Forms; their first duo album Zo is also scheduled for reissue by ESP-Disk' on November 6. Roulette lists $25 advance admission, $30 at the door, and $20 student/senior admission with ID. A free livestream is scheduled for the performance and will be archived.

en.why_it_matters: The duo is the event. Shipp and Parker have spent four decades developing a common language across New York's creative-music continuum, but Roulette is stripping that history down to piano and bass just as their fourth duo record arrives and their first is put back into circulation. The absence of a drummer or larger ensemble makes their accumulated listening, pulse and harmonic friction the entire live argument.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play around December 4, actively make room and let Roulette anchor the evening. For a corridor trip from farther south, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than make the entire trip hinge on a performance that will also be streamed and archived.

es.why_it_matters: El dúo es el evento. Shipp y Parker llevan cuatro décadas construyendo un lenguaje común dentro de la música creativa de Nueva York, y Roulette reduce toda esa historia a piano y contrabajo justo cuando aparece su cuarto disco a dúo y el primero vuelve a circular. Sin batería ni un ensamble mayor, la escucha acumulada entre ambos, el pulso y la fricción armónica quedan expuestos como todo el argumento en vivo.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego alrededor del 4 de diciembre, sí le haría espacio activamente y dejaría que Roulette ancle la noche. Para subir por el corredor desde más al sur, lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte en Nueva York en vez de hacer depender todo el viaje de una función que además tendrá transmisión y archivo.
